provenance.quote: This error is confined to a single precinct and involves only two unopposed races for the Georgia House of Representative, Ga HD 37 (Mary Frances Williams) and Ga HD 43 (Solomon Adesanya). Both races have a single candidate running unopposed, so this error cannot affect the outcome of either race. No other races are affected by the error.
